_doc: NEXT100 #13. Hours of one stock market's scan window (config.MARKET_SCAN_WINDOWS: ASX 11:00-16:45 Sydney, NASDAQ 10:30-16:45 New York, weekdays, each market's own clock) between two instants. Run by BOTH scanner/watchdog.py market_session_hours (tests/test_watchdog.py) and functions/api/health.js sessionHours (test/health.test.js), so the alarm and the site cannot disagree. Expected values are worked by hand in `why`.

cases.name: asx overnight counts nothing
